headline: 奧斯卡入圍賽情勢未明
context: 一篇奧斯卡賽前分析指出，克里斯多福‧諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）執導的《The Odyssey》，目前被視為本屆奧斯卡最大熱門。不過隨著秋季各大影展陸續登場，愈來愈多競爭者浮上檯面，戰局還沒定案。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey might be the one to beat but a crop of competitors is starting to materialise Reporting from fall film festivals used to be a more streamlined process – what’s good, what’s bad, what’s being sold, what has Oscars chances – but with each year, the season arrives with larger, more existential questions. The 2025 run, from Venice to Telluride to Toronto, was notably underwhelming and took place months after Sinners went from box-office hit to legitimate contender and at the same time as One Battle After Another skipped festivals and went on to win best picture . The pipeline that had once birthed winners such as Birdman, Spotlight, 12 Years a Slave and The King’s Speech had no longer played as big of a part with Covid-affected Nomadland being the last fall festival film to win the top prize. Even without an awards hat on, there has been a more general lack of buzz, an excitement of something new that much harder to find as more films of considerably lower quality took up underserved space. If the trades are to be believed, a lot of it is down to studios choosing against the risk of bad buzz and potential embarrassment to A-listers because for every The Shape of Water or Poor Things, there’s a White Noise or Joker: Folie à Deux. So while this season might see new films starring Tom Cruise, Timothée Chalamet, Anne Hathaway, Christian Bale, Amy Adams, Daisy Edgar-Jones, Ben Affleck and Mikey Madison, none of them are braving a festival premiere. thread_text:
一篇奧斯卡賽前分析指出，克里斯多福‧諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）執導的《The Odyssey》，目前被視為本屆奧斯卡最大熱門。不過隨著秋季各大影展陸續登場，愈來愈多競爭者浮上檯面，戰局還沒定案。 目前只有 The Guardian 提到這則分析，細節仍待補充。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 24 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 這是一篇奧斯卡賽前的分析。有評論認為，克里斯多福‧諾蘭執導的《The Odyssey》，目前是本屆奧斯卡最大熱門。不過隨著秋季影展一場接一場，愈來愈多競爭者開始浮上檯面，戰局還沒有定案。這是一則賽前觀察，說法就當參考。
